name: 71 Nyhavn Hotel
positioning: Hotel in two preserved 1800s warehouses at the end of Nyhavn in Copenhagen, with harbour-view rooms and a COBRA art collection
best_for: Travelers who want a historic harbourside base in central Copenhagen
Art lovers interested in COBRA-movement paintings
Small families wanting a suite with a sofa bed

facts.text: The hotel is a well-preserved warehouse from the 1800s at the end of Nyhavn.
Merchant Ole Bernt and Captain Just Ludvigsen built the warehouse, which was completed in 1805.
Alf Arp-Hansen bought the warehouse in 1970 and opened it as a hotel in 1971.
Rooms and suites are placed in The Yellow Warehouse and The Red Warehouse.
The rooms were gently restored with a focus on a timeless Scandinavian expression while preserving the buildings' historic soul.
Founder Alf Arp-Hansen made six paintings specifically for the hotel.
Kongens Nytorv is a neighbour and the Royal Theatre is around the corner.
A walk along the harbour front leads past Amalienborg Palace and Kastellet to the Little Mermaid.
The concierge team helps with everything from dog sitting and transfers to recommendations.
Guests can rent a bike from the hotel.
Breakfast is included whichever room you choose.
The restaurant and bar, Il Molo, serves a menu of Italian flavours.

highlights.text: Guests wake up beneath grained beams of Pomeranian pinewood in the preserved warehouse buildings.
The hotel's art collection is based on the COBRA avant-garde movement, including Asger Jorn's paintings Marche Orange and Compositio.
The Suite Deluxe View has French glass doors looking out on the harbour life and The Inner Harbour Bridge.
Executive Double Deluxe View rooms sit on the south side of The Red Warehouse, looking over the harbour or the fishing boats in Nyhavn.
Junior Suites are set across two levels connected by a spiral staircase.

considerations.text: Executive Rooms and Executive Double Deluxe rooms look onto the opposite warehouse, not the water.
In the two-level Junior Suites the bathroom is always on the lower level and may be separated from the sleeping area by a spiral staircase.
Parking behind the hotel is limited, though a public parking garage is close by.
